comment: 58yo female ('DES daughter') born 1967 with documented maternal DES use during pregnancy. No current cancer diagnosis. Bimodal-risk DES cohort — second elevated-risk window persists past age 40 (vaginal clear-cell adenocarcinoma + breast cancer modestly elevated). Fires RF-REPRODUCTIVE-DES-IN-UTERO-EXPOSURE-PREVENTION. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-DES-EXPOSURE-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (annual gynecologic + colposcopy + breast surveillance per cohort cadence); alternative = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-DES-EXPOSURE-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (general-population screening only).
